items.title: Gucci reportedly cuts prices as turnaround pressure builds
items.summary: UK trade outlet reports Gucci's crystal Padlock bag fell 30% in France (EUR3,500 to EUR2,450), the Mercato tote 20-25%, and sneakers from EUR800 to EUR560-595, framed by Kering as permanent 'targeted corrections' for overpriced items rather than markdowns, against a 6% Q3 comparable revenue decline and abandoned 2026 growth target.

items.title: After price cuts at Gucci, Kering appoints a group director of pricing
items.summary: Kering named ex-Nike executive Francisco Ochando as its first Group Director of Pricing across all brands and regions, following Gucci's summer 2026 price corrections; framed as CEO Luca de Meo institutionalizing pricing discipline under the ReconKering turnaround plan after years of price hikes eroded middle-class luxury demand.

items.title: Montres: Gucci supprime 30 postes a Cortaillod
items.summary: Gucci Swiss Timepieces will cut about 30 of 95 jobs at its Cortaillod (Neuchatel) site as logistics consolidate into Gucci's Trecate plant near Milan; a works-council consultation runs to Dec 4, the second such Swiss layoff round in two years amid a broader Swiss watch-industry downturn (Zenith, Breitling, Chopard also cutting).

items.title: Kering-Aktie: Goldman Sachs senkt Gucci-Prognose fuer Q4
items.summary: German financial wire reports Goldman Sachs deepened its Gucci Q4 organic sales forecast to a 4.3% decline, cut Kering's price target to EUR215, flagged a weaker European trend on top of soft China, but still projects a 2027 recovery (Gucci +4% organic) aided by a wider product range and holiday campaign.

items.title: La divisione orologi di Gucci taglia 30 posti di lavoro in Svizzera
items.summary: Italian trade-press confirmation of the Cortaillod layoffs, noting the restructuring shifts logistics to Gucci's Trecate facility near Milan and situating it within Kering's broader cost-discipline push across its watch and jewelry units.

items.title: Gucci se revele sous un nouveau jour sur l'avenue Montaigne
items.summary: French-language trade coverage of the Oct 30 Paris flagship reopening at 56 Avenue Montaigne (1,480 sqm, four floors), the first permanent rollout of Demna/Bellettini's 'Store Show' retail concept blending 1930s monumental architecture, Renaissance marble cues and 1950s-70s Milanese domestic finishes. Included as EU-origin context for the Nov 13 Harrods rollout rather than duplicated hard news.

items.title: Gucci.com Trustpilot reviews, November 2026
items.summary: Aggregate Trustpilot rating for gucci.com sits at 1.8/5 across 1,745 reviews (69% one-star vs 22% five-star). Recent dated entries include a Nov 16 one-star review describing a six-month refund delay and a Nov 14 one-star review citing dismissive in-store service, alongside a Nov 7 five-star review praising a Bicester boutique staff member; recurring complaint themes are refund/return delays, product-quality defects and inconsistent staff service.

items.title: "Gucci Bamboo feel cheated" discussion thread
items.summary: UK parenting/lifestyle-forum thread in which posters discuss feeling misled by a Gucci Bamboo fragrance purchase and compare notes on scent longevity and reformulation complaints -- ordinary consumer grumbling rather than brand-driven content, illustrating low-grade but persistent quality skepticism among UK shoppers.

items.title: Gucci SS27 Show thread
items.summary: PurseForum members continue debating Demna's spring 2027 collection; sentiment has warmed versus his debut, with several posters saying this is the first Demna-era look they could see themselves wearing, though skepticism about handbag design direction persists among longtime Gucci collectors.

items.title: Forum members review Demna's Fall 2026 runway debut as Gucci creative director
items.summary: Roundup of fashion-forum commentary on Demna's debut runway collection: posters called pieces 'cheap, dated, and mostly already available on Fashion Nova,' criticized leggings and styling as 'not sexy,' and faulted deliberately sloppy tailoring, alongside a smaller contingent defending the directional reset -- organic, mixed-to-negative community sentiment, independent of Gucci's own messaging.

items.title: Fans react to Mariah Carey's Gucci holiday campaign on TikTok
items.summary: TikTok reaction roundup to Gucci's Harmony Korine-directed Mariah Carey holiday campaign: user @oldloserinbrooklyn wrote 'this feels like if JCPenney was trying to be luxury,' with others calling the ad 'cold,' 'emotionless,' 'boring,' 'depressing' and 'outdated' -- a rare case of visible negative volume on a Gucci-initiated activation rather than independent news, discounted accordingly as consumer reaction to brand content rather than organic discussion.

items.title: Inside Gucci's Paris Palazzo, a Blueprint for Its Retail Revamp
items.summary: BoF's analysis of the Avenue Montaigne flagship frames the 'Store Show' concept as the clearest signal yet of Demna and Bellettini's strategy, blending Milanese-home atmosphere with product discovery; the piece treats the redesign as necessary but notes analysts remain unconvinced that store aesthetics alone can reverse Gucci's traffic and comparable-sales declines.
